newsitem.title: USA: Auto sales in U.S. off 6.7 pct April 1-10 - CNW.
newsitem.headline: Auto sales in U.S. off 6.7 pct April 1-10 - CNW.

text.p: Auto sales in the United States fell 6.7 percent in the first 10 days of April compared with the same period a year ago, according to a report by CNW Marketing/Research.
During the survey period, sales of domestic autos decreased 7.3 percent, while U.S. sales of imports gained 0.2 percent.
Specifically, domestic car sales fell 15.8 percent to 151,257 from 179,638, CNW said. Domestic truck sales rose 1.8 percent to 168,981 from 165,956, it said.
Import car sales were unchanged at 23,894, and import truck sales advanced 0.7 percent to 8,123, the report said.
Year-to-date vehicle sales in the United States reached 3,914,732, off 0.4 percent from the same period of 1996, according to CNW.
